title: InvisFrames
description: Allows players to take normal item frames and turn them invisible when placed!
body:
# InvisFrames Plugin
Allows players to take normal item frames and turn them invisible when placed! This plugin supports the usage of commands and crafting to accomplish the goal! (both can be configured)

## Crafting Recipe:
![CraftingRecipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d275e63ffc245dc159a5d7ab2521f6af3882b859.png)

## Showcase:
![showcaseart](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9c721210933b524960a156bccf7ddaf33f39275.png)

## Config file:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>


```
# InvisFrames by Cinnaminin :3
# Plugin Config
# Plugin Version 1.1

# toggle the commands for invisible item frames
commands:
  enabled: true

# toggle whether or not invisable item frams can be crafted
crafting:
  enabled: true

```

</details>
